subject.title: docs: design bounded hosted live smoke tier

question: Should Crabbox adopt this two-provider hosted live-smoke design as the repository’s policy baseline for a later credentialed workflow?
rationale: The PR intentionally does not activate a workflow, but it chooses future provider scope, funded spend limits, protected-environment access, and orphan-reconciliation operations that require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept the planning baseline
options.body: Merge the design as a non-activating policy baseline and require a separate implementation PR to satisfy its activation checklist.

options.title: Revise the operating policy first
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers change the provider allowlist, budget ceilings, credential model, or scheduled-review tradeoff.

options.title: Defer the hosted tier
options.body: Close or pause the proposal if the repository does not intend to operate a funded hosted smoke tier.

recommendation.title: Accept the planning baseline
recommendation.body: Merge the design as a non-activating policy baseline and require a separate implementation PR to satisfy its activation checklist.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor introduced the related merged lifecycle tier and supplied the present bounded design, making them the strongest available routing candidate for follow-up.
